ns2:course.label: Control System Theory & Design
ns2:course.description: Feedback control systems emphasizing state space techniques. Basic principles, modeling, analysis, stability, structural properties, optimization, and design to meet specifications. Same as ME 540 and SE 522. Prerequisite: ECE 486.
